title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Month-to-Month Maturity Extensions
content:
**Lease-end desk guidance — extending a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease past maturity**

**Status.** A maturity extension can be granted only while the lease status is active or maturity extended.

**Account condition and limit.** The lease must show days past due of 0, and the extension months already used plus the months requested must not exceed the maximum extension months for the tier. A tier whose maximum is 0 cannot extend.

**Request window.** The request may be granted no earlier than 60 calendar days (the same in every tier) before the current maturity date and no later than the current maturity date.

**Form of the extension.** Extensions are granted in whole months; each month moves the maturity date one month later on the same due day.

**During the extension.** The lessee keeps paying the total monthly payment on the same due day, and each payment's depreciation portion keeps reducing the adjusted lease balance. The former clause under which the mileage allowance grows by the annual mileage allowance divided by 12 for each extension month is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the lease's mileage allowance and no longer governs any charge. The lessee may end the extension at any time by turning the vehicle in or buying it.

**Decision table (hypothetical requests; current maturity date September 30; tier maximum 3 months)**

| Days past due | Months already used | Months requested | Request date | Grant |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 2 | August 1 (60 days before) | yes |
| 0 | 0 | 2 | July 31 (61 days before) | no — too early |
| 0 | 2 | 1 | September 30 (the maturity date) | yes |
| 0 | 2 | 2 | September 15 | no — 4 months exceed the maximum of 3 |
| 5 | 0 | 1 | September 15 | no — days past due is not 0 |

**Hypothetical illustration**: a lease maturing on September 30 with a due day of the 30th is extended by 2 months; its maturity date becomes November 30 and payments continue on the 30th of each month.

superseded_clauses: the mileage allowance grows by annual_mileage_allowance divided by 12 for each extension month.
